name: CE 3251
title: Civil and Environmental Engineering Applications of Probability and Statistics
description: Multiple regression. Analysis of variance. Student project applying probability or statistics in a civil or environmental engineering context.
requirement_description: STAT 1100Q; open only to CE and ENVE majors. This course and CE 2251 or ENVE 2251 may not both be taken for credit. Recommended preparation: MATH 1121 or 1131Q or 1151Q.
